contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen fix

actions.description: It will reveal physical or liquid issues

steps: Inspect phone, charger, and USB cable for damage or liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories covering ports or buttons.
Examine USB connections for corrosion or bent pins.
Ensure USB connection feels secure with minimal movement.

actions.description: It will confirm moisture exposure status

steps: Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert ejector tool into hole next to SIM/MicroSD tray to eject tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.
Observe LDI color; pink, purple, or red indicates moisture exposure.
If LDI is solid white or white with pink/purple Xs, no moisture detected.

actions.description: It will replenish battery power

steps: Connect phone or tablet to appropriate charger and let charge for at least 1 hour.
Wait up to 10 minutes for charging indicator to appear on display.

actions.description: It will arrange professional repair

steps: If screen still black after all steps, contact Customer Support Center for assistance.

actions.description: It will reboot the device forcibly

steps: Press and hold Power (or Side) and Volume down buttons simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If battery removable, remove it for 60 seconds then reinsert.

actions.description: It will try turning screen on

steps: Disconnect device from charger.
Press and hold Power (or Side) button for 15 to 20 seconds.
Observe for TechCorp Nexa logo indicating successful power on.
